basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. I have a passion for creative storytelling through digital art and spend my free time gaming, exploring new music, and keeping up with the latest TV dramas. I've been with my partner for three years, and we love attending local art shows and trying out food trucks around the city. I'm usually online during the evenings and late nights, especially after a long day at work. Big fan of casual gaming and always on the lookout for new mods to enhance my experience.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I studied graphic design in college and have been working in the industry for about five years. My expertise lies in digital illustration and branding. I am also a self-taught gaming enthusiast with a knack for modding and customizing games for a more immersive experience.
